title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.0 Release Candidate 5
summary: Version 1.0.0 Release Candidate 5 removes a deprecated mystery option and explains unavailable or dependent settings directly in the interface instead of relying on tooltips that disabled WinForms controls cannot display.
changes: Hides Use Key Mappings because that inherited PowerToys-era checkbox is deprecated, permanently disabled, and disconnected from settings.
Relabels the two unavailable sign-in controls to state directly that they require the Windows service omitted from this portable edition.
Marks Transfer file as requiring Share Clipboard whenever clipboard sharing is switched off, then restores its normal label when available.
Closes the visual gap left by the removed key-mapping checkbox.
Keeps the responsive RC4 shortcut layout and all supported shortcut behavior unchanged.
testing: Open Other Options and confirm Use Key Mappings is absent rather than greyed out.
Confirm the two grey sign-in controls say service required directly in their labels.
Turn off Share Clipboard and confirm Transfer file becomes unavailable and says it requires Share Clipboard; turn sharing back on and confirm both recover.
Confirm the RC4 keyboard-shortcut spacing remains correct at normal and maximized Settings sizes.
Start RC5 in a fresh folder and confirm every shortcut defaults to disabled.
Open About and confirm the displayed product version is 1.0.0-rc.5.
Run the same RC5 EXE on both computers and briefly recheck mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, and reconnect behavior.
